items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They were built by a woman, Pontalba. She was born in New Orleans and went back – went to France and spent a lot of years there.

ctx.x: See them building that go around it? They were built by a woman, Pontalba. She was born in New Orleans and went back – went to France and spent a lot of years there. When she came back here, she built those apartments. I’m trying to think. It’s in the paper today. It’s easy to find out things historically now. All you got to do is google it.
Although I’m not going to trust what I read online that much. I always want to try to corroborate it. Let me ask you . . .
